conclusions: The generic replaceItems event selects one explicit player. Its public used-model pane is cleared for every viewer, while physical hand replacement executes only for that player as the current viewer. No dead/Fog guard or global survivor distribution loop exists in this branch.

Replacement consumes one supplied row per old nonempty widget, including used miracles. Empty placeholders keep widget identity and consume no row. Short input throws after earlier visual changes; extra rows remain unused.

The real decoders and widget projection accept supplied duplicate/zero physical IDs and supplied model/fake/used values without sampling, retokening, Dream validation or forcing unused. Unknown model ranges can fail later in widget construction;decoder acceptance alone is not legality.

Fresh snapshots differ: they rebuild the viewer own hand to the supplied count and append public used models from supplied used flags, preferring fake over actual. The fresh Fog branch hides alive enemy panes of a living Fog viewer but does not prevent underlying widget updates.

The adapter exact permutation/count preservation/retokening/dead exclusion/used preservation/private fake clearing are deliberate local contracts. These probes establish receive/display mechanics,not server shuffle selection or fanout.
limitations: No dedicated shuffleItemsOfEverybody receiver or authoritative server implementation is available from this public client. Event ordering,eligible roles,physical identity policy,used status transformation,random distribution and recipient item-count allocation remain unverified.
Fresh-state widgets start empty public used panes as normal construction would;roster DOM allocation and final command activation are stubbed. No server fanout or live backend snapshot is replayed.
Raw fake records render even without a Dream curse. This does not justify allowing illegal Match fake states or publicly revealing private true models after a move.

The incremental and fresh paths are independent renderer examples,not proof that295 necessarily uses one or the other. Do not import the old Flash server policy or the v29 hat redraw new-unused policy into current295 authority.
No source JavaScript is embedded in this report. No application startup,network,account,DOM,timer or game connection runs.
